name: YFlix Local
description: YFlix Local v0.4.0. S2 was rebuilt around title-verified VidBolt Quasar HLS to prevent wrong-video playback. S4 was simplified to FilmU Singularity HLS after Pulsar failed on-device.

scrapers.name: YFlix · Server 1

scrapers.name: YFlix · Server 2
scrapers.description: YFlix Server 2 (Multi Dubbed): strict VidBolt Quasar build. Only HLS rows whose names match the requested title/year and, for TV, exact SxxExx are returned.
